list.title: Traffic Sources
list.emptyDescription: Add the places your traffic comes from — campaigns reference these by name.

form.description: Traffic sources are where your campaigns' traffic comes from.
form.costIntegrationHint: Manual entries are logged per campaign on its Cost tab. Facebook/TikTok/Google Ads connect credentials below, then a scheduled sync pulls spend automatically every few hours for campaigns whose External campaign ID matches — "Sync now" runs it immediately.

validation.nameMin: Name must be at least 2 characters

connection.title: Connected ad account
connection.description: Stores the credentials the spend sync below uses. A scheduled sync runs automatically every few hours; "Sync now" runs it immediately for the last 30 days and writes matches to each campaign's Cost tab (matched by External campaign ID).
connection.savedRequiredNotice: Save the source first — the ad account ID and access token fields appear right after.
connection.googleAdsHint: Mint the refresh token once via Google's OAuth 2.0 Playground using your own Google Ads developer token and OAuth client — FLOX has no registered public callback to run its own OAuth consent flow. For offline conversions, mint it with both scopes: Google Ads and https://www.googleapis.com/auth/datamanager.

syncResult.title: Last sync result
syncResult.unmatchedHint: No FLOX campaign has this External campaign ID yet — set it on a campaign's Settings tab to start matching.

rowActions.archiveConfirmDescription: Archived sources are hidden from campaign source pickers going forward. This can be reversed later.

postback.title: Network template and postback to the source
postback.description: Tell the ad network about conversions so it can optimize: FLOX calls this URL when a conversion of this source's clicks is recorded.
postback.linkHint: In the campaign's tracking link builder, {{name}} fills these parameters with its macros:

caution.postback: This postback format comes from a tracker's documentation, not the network's own: compare it with the postback in your network account.
caution.clickId: The click-id macro comes from a tracker's documentation only: check it in your network account.

postback.urlHint: Replace REPLACE_… with the values from your account at the network. {external_click_id} is the network's own click id the click carried, {revenue} the conversion's payout.
postback.replaceLeft: Replace the REPLACE_… parts with the values from your network account
postback.statusesHint: Usually only the approved conversion: each status sent counts as a conversion at the network.

offline.title: Offline conversions to Google Ads
offline.description: Leads and purchases of clicks from Google (with a gclid) are sent back to Google Ads, so Google sees which ads bring sales and can bid for them. Only conversions recorded after turning this on are sent, every 5 minutes.
offline.actionsHint: Google Ads conversion action ids with the source “Import from clicks” (Goals › Conversions › the action › ctId in its URL). Empty: that status is not sent. A refund restates an already sent purchase's value.
offline.scopeHint: The refresh token must be minted with the https://www.googleapis.com/auth/datamanager scope (Data Manager API enabled in the Google Cloud project), and your Google account must have access to the ad account. Otherwise Google refuses the upload — the reason shows below.

skipped.no_google_click_one: {{count}} conversion — its click had no gclid (not from Google, or no auto-tagging)
skipped.no_google_click_other: {{count}} conversions — their clicks had no gclid (not from Google, or no auto-tagging)
skipped.no_action_one: {{count}} conversion — no action named for its status
skipped.no_action_other: {{count}} conversions — no action named for their status
skipped.click_not_found_one: {{count}} conversion — its click was not found
skipped.click_not_found_other: {{count}} conversions — their clicks were not found

metrica.title: Offline conversions to Yandex Metrica
metrica.description: Leads and purchases of clicks from Yandex Direct (with a yclid) are uploaded to the Metrica counter on your landing; Metrica passes them on to Direct, which can then optimize for sales. Only conversions recorded after turning this on are sent, every 5 minutes; Metrica takes up to 3 hours to match them.
metrica.loadError: Could not load the Yandex Metrica settings:
metrica.tokenKeep: stored, ends in {{last4}} — leave empty to keep
metrica.goalsHint: Identifiers of the counter's “JavaScript event” goals (condition “matches”). Empty: that status is not sent. Values are converted to the counter's currency at the conversion's date. Metrica cannot change an uploaded conversion: a later refund stays in Metrica.
metrica.setupHint: The token needs the metrika:offline_data (or metrika:write) scope and access to the counter. The counter must be on the landing and the landing's address must carry the yclid — add yclid={yclid} to the offer or landing URL. Only visits of the last 21 days can be matched.

skipped.no_yandex_click_one: {{count}} conversion — its click had no yclid (not from Direct, or no auto-tagging)
skipped.no_yandex_click_other: {{count}} conversions — their clicks had no yclid (not from Direct, or no auto-tagging)
skipped.visit_too_old_one: {{count}} conversion — its click is older than 21 days, Metrica no longer matches it
skipped.visit_too_old_other: {{count}} conversions — their clicks are older than 21 days, Metrica no longer matches them
skipped.no_action_one: {{count}} conversion — no goal named for its status
skipped.no_action_other: {{count}} conversions — no goal named for their status
skipped.click_not_found_one: {{count}} conversion — its click was not found
skipped.click_not_found_other: {{count}} conversions — their clicks were not found
